# Image Generation Prompts

Mode: OpenAI built-in image generation.

## Fictional ID-style portrait

```text
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: synthetic browser-upload test fixture
Primary request: Create a completely fictional adult person's neutral ID-style portrait for software image-upload testing.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly even plain white studio background.
Subject: one fictional East Asian adult, front-facing, head and shoulders, neutral natural expression, eyes open, no glasses, no hat, tidy dark hair, wearing a simple medium-blue crew-neck shirt with no logos.
Style/medium: realistic studio photography, natural skin texture, clearly synthetic and not based on any real person.
Composition/framing: vertical portrait, face centered, both shoulders visible, generous clean margin above the hair, symmetric straight-on camera.
Lighting/mood: soft even passport-photo lighting, no dramatic shadows.
Constraints: no text, no watermark, no border, no jewelry, no uniform, no brand, no identifiable real person; pure white background; high detail suitable for resizing and JPEG compression tests.
```

## Detailed landscape

```text
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: synthetic browser-upload test fixture
Primary request: Create a richly detailed landscape photograph for testing image resizing, center-cropping, and JPEG compression.
Scene/backdrop: a mountain lake with pine forest, layered rocky slopes, textured clouds, and reflections on the water.
Style/medium: realistic high-detail travel photography, entirely generic and not depicting a recognizable landmark.
Composition/framing: wide horizontal 3:2 composition; strong detail across the entire frame; clear foreground, midground, and background.
Lighting/mood: bright natural daylight with moderate contrast.
Constraints: no people, no buildings, no signs, no text, no watermark, no logos; include plenty of fine natural texture that makes compression artifacts measurable.
```

## Color still life

```text
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: synthetic browser-upload test fixture
Primary request: Create a colorful square still-life image for testing PNG/JPEG/WebP conversion, aspect-ratio cropping, and compression.
Scene/backdrop: matte light-gray tabletop with a clean soft-gray studio backdrop.
Subject: a generic cobalt-blue ceramic mug, a small orange, a red notebook with no writing, and two green leaves arranged as a balanced still life.
Style/medium: realistic clean studio product photography with crisp edges and varied colors.
Composition/framing: centered square composition with comfortable margins; distinct object boundaries and both smooth gradients and textured details.
Lighting/mood: soft studio lighting, mild natural shadows.
Constraints: no logos, no words, no labels, no watermark, no brand identifiers.
```
